## Feathered King (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
Tengu rogue 4  

NE Medium humanoid (tengu)  

**Init** +4; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +8  



**Defense**



**AC** 18, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +4 Dex)  

**hp** 40 (4d8+8)  

**Fort** +3, **Ref** +9, **Will** +4  

**Defensive Abilities** evasion, trap sense +1, uncanny dodge  



**Offense**



**Speed** 30 ft.  

**Melee** mwk short sword +8 (1d6+4/19–20), bite +2 (1d3+3)  

**Ranged** composite shortbow +7 (1d6+1/×3)  

**Special Attacks** sneak attack +2d6  



**Statistics**



**Str** 12, **Dex** 18, **Con** 12, **Int** 10, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 8  

**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7; **CMD** 18  

**Feats** Skill Focus (Acrobatics), Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  

**Skills** Acrobatics +13, Appraise +4, Climb +7, Disable Device +8, Knowledge (local) +7, Knowledge (nobility) +1, Linguistics +9, Perception +8, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +12, Survival +4, Use Magic Device +6  

**Languages** Common, Goblin, Halfling, Tengu, +2 additional  

**SQ** gifted linguist, rogue talents (fast stealth, ledge walker), swordtrained, trapfinding +2, trap sense +1, uncanny dodge  

**Combat Gear** potion of cure moderate wounds, potions of jump (3), smokesticks (2); **Other Gear** masterwork chain shirt, masterwork short sword, composite shortbow (+1 Str) with 20 arrows, cloak of resistance +1, climber’s kit, grappling hook, silk rope (100 ft.), thieves’ tools, tindertwigs (5)
